agent_priors_used: Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): long-horizon agents fail via compounding error and path dependence, so verification-before-store gates plus step-level fallback are the load-bearing product mechanism — used to keep Product/Runtime pointed at guards and coverage certificates rather than resolver tuning.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): memory beating no-memory is weak evidence; the load-bearing comparison is parameterized inheritance vs strong retrieval/compiled-procedural baselines at matched correctness on non-ceiling banks — used to protect the SBA-V3 multi-scale test against degenerate positive readings.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): cache/replay economics are dominated by recurrence rate h and fully-loaded write/verify/repair cost, not per-read compression ratios — used to route C-PRODUCT-ECON through first-party h(N)/Cwrite/Cmiss measurement and to bar stacking external compression with replay savings.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): observation representation (hidden affordances, selector exposure, accessibility tree) is a first-order confound in LLM-agent capability probes, separable from raw multi-step control — used to justify Intel's representation probe before any credential-gating conclusion on B3.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): repeated MEASUREMENT_INVALID/REVISE with a shared cause is an upstream satisfiability/substrate defect to repair once or park, not a thread to extend — used to cap Physics estimator-battery work, hold the localhost N stop rule, and force Frontier/Graph repairs-or-park.

allocation.rationale: Frontier is the only idle lane and its last result is MEASUREMENT_INVALID (frame defect + harness-envelope mismatch), not a scientific falsification of persistence economics. The discovery axis closed on this substrate (0/208), but maintenance/invalidation economics is a materially different question that directly feeds first-party persistence economics. Cognitive reset applied: with no inherited question the lane would still probe whether persisted paths pay their revalidation cost, since that is the cheapest unanswered work-compression question on this substrate. Fund the repaired design ONCE with V3-gate-first sequencing and the endpoint-only fallback; any further invalid or null parks the thread in favor of a genuinely orthogonal basin.

Five lanes carry frozen/prefrozen portfolio mandates that already encode the correct repairs, so five CONTINUEs preserve those transactions. Frontier, the sole idle lane, is reactivated with a single bounded repaired-design attempt (V3-gate-first, endpoint-only fallback) because its last result was operational invalidity, not falsification — a second invalid or null parks it. No expensive C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON flagship execution is authorized: B1 is exercised via the SBA-V3 derisk, B2 is discharged, B3 remains NOT_SATISFIED pending Intel's probe.
